notes.title: Help us with the FreshWomen - Season 2 Save System!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/67e2e5bc4f6bb78eb78666b6_25-09-2025-01-09-49-197_capa-post-2.jpg[/img] 

Hey FreshMen,


With just under a month to go before the launch of Season 2, our hearts are racing more than ever!
Our team is hard at work on fixes and polish to make sure your experience is as perfect as possible.


One of the key things we want to guarantee is that loading a save from Season 1 works flawlessly in Season 2.
We’ve done plenty of internal testing and fixed several bugs, but now we’d love your help with the final round of tests!


We’ve prepared a special test build that includes the save generator and the first scene of Episode 6.
It’s available for download directly on the Steam page for Season 2:


To help us, just download the build, load a save from Season 1, and test it out! If it doesn’t work, you can send us more details along with your save file here: https://forms.gle/BpU877doodDiF2uCA


[b]How to proceed:[/b]
- Download the Playtest here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478650/FreshWomen__Season_2/
- Run the game and click Continue to load your Season 1 save.
- If you’d like to replay Season 1, you’ll be redirected to download the full game.
- During the process, a Google Form link will appear so you can fill it out if a save error occurs.


This build will be available for one week. We’ll be rolling out small updates if we find additional fixes.


As always, thank you so much for your support!
Our big day is almost here, and we couldn’t be more excited.
 
Thanks to you, FreshWomen - Season 2 is becoming a reality.


See you soon,
f1r3

notes.title: Welcoming Pantsu Interactive to the OppaiMan Studios Family.
notes.content:
[url=https://www.oppaiman.com/posts/welcoming-pantsu-interactive-to-the-oppaiman-studios-family/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=welcoming-pantsu-interactive-to-the-oppaiman-studios-family&utm_medium=post&utm_id=own][img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/67e2e5bc4f6bb78eb78666b6_28-07-2025-07-12-30-479_poll.jpg[/img][/url]
We're happy to say that our company grew to 36 people, and we now have several teams, games, and products.
And we felt the need to give a special name to each one of our teams to avoid the confusion of everyone being under the same name.

From now on, our collective of development teams is now called "OppaiMan Studios"
And the team behind FreshWomen is now called "Pantsu Interactive".
It's the same people you already know, just under a new and personalized name.

Congratulations to the team of FreshWomen for their new brand and name!

notes.title: New Lip Textures and Updated Debra
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/67e1e47180f6d72cd18432cc_16-07-2025-01-32-06-506_Lips.png[/img] I always felt like there was a lack of primary volumes in the characters' mouths, they were always very smooth, even with normal maps using high values the details were discreet, and I asked my colleague to make some displacement maps in zbrush for the lips, we had some interesting results as you can see above. Wishlist Season 2's New Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478650/FreshWomen__Season_2/

Updated Debra

Working on this character made me think about how important character consistency is when it's bad, and it seems a bit bad to me to stick to the past in some cases and certain characters, below is a comparison of adjustments made to her: Updated Debra [img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/posts/f48de7481d8857913e3f76ddaa5aa24bc8a494dc09a6269bdb15ee9fe9c9662e.png[/img] Old Debra [img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/posts/b828e8cfde749b2cd675cd0d65ad0607aa84a49407cafb6d4259f3f4addc454c.png[/img] - RedLeep
